## Selection rules

{
  "uniform": "Endpoints included; rational i*(N-1)/(K-1), nearest ties-to-even; duplicates rejected; offset zero; position uniform, not time uniform.",
  "fixed_fps_4": "Origin first authorized native PTS; t0+k/4 <= last native PTS; nearest native frame, exact distance tie earlier index; unique sorted positions; always append last authorized endpoint.",
  "no_gt_dependency": true,
  "d_min": "D_MIN_NOT_DEFINED_BY_EXISTING_SAMPLING_CONTRACT",
  "event_detection_guarantee": "NOT_ESTABLISHED"
}

## Frozen Sampling Resolvability interpretation

`src/memory_graph/pass_t/phase2a_v2/finalize.py:sampling(response,item,strides)` accepts explicit positive integer frame strides, no default. BEFORE/AFTER cited frame positions form inclusive envelopes; each offset 0…k−1 tests position%k==offset hits in both envelopes. Returned all-offset success is envelope evidence availability, not every interior frame being informative and not model recognition. Native endpoint PTS and bracket duration are reported; selection is index based. No d_min field exists. This task did not run any GT-informed diagnostic.

Physical transition duration, visually informative duration, BEFORE/AFTER separation, native acquisition interval, and model input temporal resolution are distinct. Neither a wide bracket nor Δ≤d_min/2 proves both states, correct target, event class, or VLM success. Native VFR gaps and processor resampling further constrain coverage. Detection guarantee: NOT_ESTABLISHED. Uniform_3 has much larger gaps; higher density increases intersections but cannot establish reasoning superiority.
